resources.string: Say “你好小悦” while the app is in the foreground, then speak a request. Wake detection and Chinese speech recognition run offline. Audio is neither saved nor uploaded. Listening pauses in the background or when locked. Built-in prompts are available; without an offline Chinese TTS voice, brief audio and full text feedback are used.

Chinese commands: 打开遮天 (open a shelf book), 打开发现 (discovery), 返回书架 (bookshelf), 切换到漫画分组 (switch group), 打开第4本书 (open book 4), 上一页 / 下一页 (previous / next page), 开启 / 关闭眼动翻页 (eye page turning). Book numbers follow the displayed group order and exclude group folders.
The voice assistant needs microphone permission. Allow access, then enable it again.
Use AI to understand complex requests

Optional, requires Internet. Understands authors, recent reading and current page context, and plans up to 4 steps. Ambiguous requests require a choice. Sends recognized text, current page and book, names, authors and reading times of up to 100 books, and up to 50 group names. Audio, book content and source URLs are never uploaded. Basic commands remain available offline when disabled.
